'''''The Dance of the Hawk and the Hummingbird''''', by [[Teven Aerwin]], is a book "which purported to set forth the proper conduct of men toward women and women toward men."{{ref/book|2|5}} Lady [[Amalisa Jagad]]'s copy was burnt by [[Liandrin]].
